backend/main.mo: Main actor implementing authentication, user profiles, product/order/bill management with role-based access control, blob storage, and migration support for a general store billing system.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that transforms old bill records to new format by adding payment status, payment reference, and payment gateway ID fields.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implemented features including billing address update, barcode scanner replacement, haptic feedback, auto-quantity increment, and scanning overlay UI.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend components including routing, hooks, pages, and UI components for the store's web application.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color palette defining light and dark theme variables for the application.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with PWA meta tags, camera permission description, and manifest link for Maa Bhawani General Store progressive web app.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA manifest defining app name, icons, theme colors, and display settings for standalone mobile app experience.
frontend/public/service-worker.js: Service worker implementing cache-first strategy for static assets and network-first for API calls with offline fallback support.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, checkout, admin, billing, settings, and store details pages.
frontend/src/components/AdminGuard.tsx: Protects admin routes by checking authentication status via Internet Identity and provides a login dialog for admin credentials with principal copying and session management.
frontend/src/components/AdminProductForm: Form component for adding new products with fields for name, category, price, barcode, and image upload with progress tracking and duplicate barcode validation.
frontend/src/components/AdminProductList: Displays a table of all products with images and provides delete functionality with confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/components/BarcodeScanner.t: Camera-based barcode scanner using Quagga2 library loaded from CDN, with flash toggle, haptic feedback, beep sound, and scan cooldown to prevent duplicates.
frontend/src/components/BillHistoryTable: Displays searchable table of all generated bills with view, print, and CSV export functionality.
frontend/src/components/BillTemplate.tsx: Renders a printable bill template with shop details, customer info, itemized list, and total amount formatted for 80mm thermal printers.
frontend/src/components/CallUsButton.tsx: Fixed floating button in bottom-right corner that initiates a phone call to the shop number (9142876085).
frontend/src/components/CartDrawer.tsx: A slide-out drawer component that displays shopping cart items with quantities, prices, and subtotal, supporting swipe-to-close gestures and navigation to checkout. Includes cart clearing functionality and empty state handling.
frontend/src/components/CategoryFilter.t: A horizontally scrollable category filter component that displays category buttons and highlights the selected category.
An informational alert component displaying the store's delivery policy: free within 1km, ₹20 per km beyond.
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: A React error boundary class component that catches rendering errors, displays error details with stack traces, and provides reset and navigation options.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: A footer component displaying store information, contact details with phone and map links, delivery info, and attribution to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: A sticky header component with store branding, navigation links, shopping cart icon with item count badge, and Internet Identity login/logout functionality.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: A layout wrapper component that combines Header, Footer, and CallUsButton with a gradient background and centers main content.
frontend/src/components/MobileRechargeSe: A form component for mobile recharge orders with fields for phone number, operator selection, and amount, requiring authentication to submit.
frontend/src/components/PaymentQRCode.ts: A card component displaying payment amount and QR code image with step-by-step UPI payment instructions.
frontend/src/components/PhoneNumberSetup: An empty component file with no content.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: A product card component displaying product image, category badge, name, price, and an add-to-cart button that requires authentication.
frontend/src/components/ProductGrid.tsx: Displays a filterable grid of products with category filtering, loading skeletons, and empty state handling using ProductCard components.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Manages the backend actor instance with authentication, creating authenticated or anonymous actors based on Internet Identity state and invalidating dependent queries on actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks for login/logout functionality, managing auth client creation and identity state with delegation validation.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend operations including products, cart, orders, recharge orders, bills, and authentication with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color palette using OKLCH, touch-friendly utilities, thermal printer styles for 80mm bills, and barcode scanner animations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard displaying statistics cards for products, orders, and bills with tabbed interface for managing products and viewing bill history, protected by AdminGuard.
frontend/src/pages/AdminSettingsPage.tsx: Admin settings page for configuring shop slogan with live preview using a mock bill template, protected by AdminGuard with navigation back to admin panel.
frontend/src/pages/BillingPage.tsx: Admin-only billing page that supports barcode scanning (camera or manual entry) to add products to a bill, manage quantities, calculate totals, and generate/print bills with customer details.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Checkout page where authenticated users enter delivery details (name, phone, address, distance), calculates total price including distance-based delivery fees, and places orders.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main landing page displaying a store banner image, mobile recharge section, and a product grid for browsing groceries.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Order confirmation page showing order ID, payment QR code, next steps instructions, and action buttons to continue shopping or call the store.
frontend/src/pages/StoreDetailsPage.tsx: Store information page displaying contact details, location with embedded map, delivery policy, store hours, and available services.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting and managing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color scheme using OKLCH, container settings, extended theme properties, animations, and plugin integrations.
project_state.json: Project state file for a POS app with barcode scanning for Bardiha Turki store in Bihar. Tracks 7 existing features including billing address updates, replacing Quagga2 scanner with high-performance alternative, haptic feedback, auto-quantity increment, scanning overlay UI, payment gateway sync, and camera permission descriptions.
